description: Free SFX libraries, packs and ambience for video, games, podcasts and streams.
description_zh: 面向视频、游戏、播客与直播的免费音效库、音效包与氛围音。

entries.name: Freesound
entries.description: Massive collaborative database of sounds under CC0 and CC-BY licenses.
entries.description_zh: 以 CC0 与 CC-BY 许可为主的大型协作声音数据库。
entries.notes: Filter by license; CC-BY sounds need credit in your description.
entries.notes_zh: 按许可证筛选；CC-BY 声音需在简介中署名。

entries.name: ZapSplat
entries.description: 100,000+ free sound effects; free tier works with attribution.
entries.description_zh: 10 万+ 免费音效；免费档需署名。
entries.notes: Gold membership removes attribution and raises quality limits.
entries.notes_zh: Gold 会员可免署名并提高下载质量上限。

entries.name: Pixabay Sound Effects
entries.description: Royalty-free sound effects library from Pixabay.

entries.name: Mixkit Sound Effects
entries.description: Free SFX for videos, games and streams from Envato's Mixkit.
entries.description_zh: Envato Mixkit 的免费音效，适用于视频、游戏与直播。

entries.name: BBC Sound Effects
entries.description: 33,000+ sounds from the historic BBC archive.
entries.description_zh: BBC 历史档案中的 33,000+ 声音。
entries.notes: NOT free for commercial or monetized content; great for learning and research.
entries.notes_zh: 不可用于商业或已货币化内容；适合学习与研究。

entries.name: Sonniss GDC Audio Bundles
entries.description: Multi-gigabyte professional game audio packs released free every year.
entries.description_zh: 每年免费发放的数 GB 专业游戏音频包。

entries.name: Orange Free Sounds
entries.description: Large mixed library of free sounds, loops and ringtones.
entries.description_zh: 大型混合免费声音、循环与铃声库。

entries.name: SoundBible
entries.description: Simple, no-frills free sound effect downloads.
entries.description_zh: 简单直接的免费音效下载站。

entries.name: Freesfx.co.uk
entries.description: Thousands of free sound effects usable with a credit.
entries.description_zh: 数千个免费音效，使用时需署名。

entries.name: Kenney Audio
entries.description: CC0 audio packs (UI, sci-fi, RPG) from the prolific Kenney library.
entries.description_zh: 高产素材库 Kenney 的 CC0 音频包（UI、科幻、RPG）。

entries.name: Tabletop Audio
entries.description: Ambience loops for tabletop RPG sessions, streams and podcasts.
entries.description_zh: 适合跑团、直播与播客的氛围循环音。
entries.notes: NonCommercial only: fine for personal and non-monetized use.
entries.notes_zh: 仅限非商业：可用于个人及未货币化内容。
